# Grammar reference and source-access record

Primary reference supplied by the user:

https://www.rae.es/gram%C3%A1tica/%C3%ADndice/sintaxis

The RAE syntax index is a navigation aid to grammatical reference material,
not a rule that institutional documents must follow one prose template. Select
the relevant material on agreement, verb complements, pronouns, relative
clauses, coordination, subordination and information structure when resolving
a concrete grammatical question. Record the exact consulted entry if citing it.
